fato_historico: 1987: The Jaffna hospital massacre is carried out by Indian peacekeeping forces in Sri Lanka, killing 70 Tamil patients, doctors and nurses.

It is a good time to nurture your spirit with kindness, remembering that even in challenging shadows, your radiant optimism remains a powerful force for global hope.
frase_do_dia: Your gentle presence is a beacon of healing light for those around you today.
significado_numero: A powerful number representing spiritual awakening and deep inner wisdom.
conselho: Prioritize acts of gentle kindness to uplift your own spirit and others.
